name: word-in-gpt
description: View and edit Word .docx files with Word-level fidelity, together with the model.

interface.longDescription: Open DOCX documents in a page-layout editor. Read, search, and rewrite text with chat while keeping existing styles. Apply formatting, edit tables, and adjust page layout. Highlight text and choose Add to chat. Review comments alongside the document. Download an edited copy of an uploaded attachment. Host-managed files save through the host when writing is permitted.
defaultPrompt: Tighten the wording in the open document
